answer: VDF timing proofs at the juniper gate: each identity must burn a sequential 10-minute delay to register, and every attestation carries a non-parallelizable timing proof. The bridge between identity and reward only opens for proven elapsed work. A meadow of 1,000 sybils costs 10,000 sequential CPU-minutes no hardware farm can compress, since delays cannot parallelize. The mechanism works because attacker cost scales linearly with identity count while honest users pay the same fixed toll once.
